(1) We propose a novel instance-aware selective branching network, named ISBNet, which can dynamically bypass transformation branches with insignificant importance weight to achieve efficient inference; (2) We conduct comprehensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet datasets, which demonstrate that ISBNet can significantly improve the efficiency of existing networks with negligible accuracy loss; and (3) ISBNet can be used as a drop-in replacement for existing networks, which can be easily deployed on edge devices.
